turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? A zero went in my son's gradebook before anyone called me.
I'm not here for compliments. Who decided on the zero, and what do you have?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
Flattery isn't evidence, Hale. Show me what you have on Owen's essay.
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
I'm relaxed when my son's mark is fixed. Who decided on the zero?
